newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain approves rules on workplace conditions.
newsitem.headline: Spain approves rules on workplace conditions.

text.p: The government has approved new safety and health measures that will apply to the workplace, designed to bring Spain in line with European Community directives, the Labour Ministry said on Friday.
The measures include providing breaks for employees and allotting a maximum duration that employees can sit in front of computer screens.

Employers must ensure the workplace abides by rules on temperature, ventilation, hygiene and rest points. Employers must also provide clear signs on range of directions including those relating to fire and prohibitions.
Finally, the government will introduce new rules for manual work involving deliveries.
